rendererDecision.rule: Use HTML for deterministic type, geometry, charts, entities and edges. Use Codex only to create non-deterministic visual assets, then place those assets in an HTML page when exact copy is required.

contextRouting.rule: The harness derives the expected layout from context.visualRole and rejects a conflicting fixture spec.layout.

forbiddenSubstitutions: Do not replace a required photo or 3D asset with generic vectors.
Do not ask Codex to redraw exact tables, charts or graph labels.
Do not infer facts, metrics, names or relationships absent from the source.

internalGap.rule: A distant footer note cannot make a shallow process rail look vertically complete.

processAlignment.rule: Every process dot center must sit on the shared rail. Vertical presets also keep at least 12px clear between the rail dot and label.

editorialSurface.rule: Cover and break copy use naked typography and hairlines. Large pale text cards with an attached accent-top rule are forbidden.

headlineLanguage.rule: Operational and cover headlines use direct noun phrases or time-plus-action labels unless the user supplied the exact sentence.

photoFocal.rule: Photo scenarios must declare a focal position and a deliberate crop scale.

moduleFeatureBalance.rule: Distribute semantic anchors across the feature panel. Do not leave the label cluster stranded in one quadrant.

compositionPresetRule: Every HTML section chooses one validated spatial composition. A preset changes reading order or geometry, never colour alone.

hybridProcessVisual.rule: HTML owns process labels and rail. Codex owns one text-free illustration in the right visual field.

graphContract.layoutRule: Compute positions from topology. Scenario data never provides fixed x/y coordinates.

proseContract.headline: One claim per slide. Use a regular premise and bold conclusion when the sentence supports it.
proseContract.labels: Use short noun phrases and preserve domain terminology.
proseContract.warnings: Use red only for a real negative finding, gap or risk.
